tooltip.destinymod.melting_point.title: MELTING POINT
tooltip.destinymod.melting_point.desc:
While standing in a <keyword:Sunspot>, and for 3s afterward, <ability:Throwing Hammer> inflicts targets with <keyword:Melting Point> for 8s.

Targets affected by <keyword:Melting Point> take 20% more damage from all sources, and the threshold to trigger an <keyword:Ignition> is reduced.
